schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE dipartimenti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    descrizione TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE docenti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    dipartimento_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES dipartimenti(id)
);

CREATE TABLE corsi (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    codice_corso TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    descrizione TEXT,
    crediti INT NOT NULL CHECK (crediti >= 0),
    dipartimento_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES dipartimenti(id),
    docente_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES docenti(id)
);

CREATE TABLE studenti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    data_nascita DATE NOT NULL,
    codice_fiscale TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE iscrizioni (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    studente_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES studenti(id),
    corso_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES corsi(id),
    data_iscrizione DATE NOT NULL,
    voto NUMERIC(3,1) CHECK (voto BETWEEN 0 AND 30),
    UNIQUE (studente_id, corso_id)
);

query: WITH report_studenti AS (SELECT s.id AS studente_id, s.nome, s.cognome, d.nome AS dipartimento, AVG(i.voto) AS media_voti, COUNT(i.id) AS numero_corsi, SUM(CASE WHEN i.voto >= 28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS corsi_meritati, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.voto >= 30) AS corsi_ecellenti FROM studenti s JOIN iscrizioni i ON s.id = i.studente_id JOIN corsi c ON i.corso_id = c.id JOIN dipartimenti d ON c.dipartimento_id = d.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nome, s.cognome, d.nome HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= 1), report_dipartimenti AS (SELECT d.id AS dipartimento_id, d.nome AS dipartimento, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS totale_studenti, AVG(i.voto) AS media_dipartimentale, MAX(i.voto) AS voto_massimo, SUM(i.voto) AS somma_voti FROM dipartimenti d JOIN corsi c ON d.id = c.dipartimento_id JOIN iscrizioni i ON c.id = i.corso_id JOIN studenti s ON i.studente_id = s.id GROUP BY d.id, d.nome), coppie_cognome AS (SELECT s1.id AS id1, s1.nome AS nome1, s2.id AS id2, s2.nome AS nome2, s1.cognome FROM studenti s1 JOIN studenti s2 ON s1.cognome = s2.cognome AND s1.id < s2.id), studenti_non_iscritti AS (SELECT s.id, s.nome, s.cognome FROM studenti s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iscrizioni i WHERE i.studente_id = s.id)) SELECT rs.nome, rs.cognome, rs.dipartimento, rs.media_voti, rs.numero_corsi, rs.corsi_meritati, rs.corsi_ecellenti, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.media_voti DESC) AS posizione, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studenti) AS totale_studenti_universita, (SELECT AVG(i2.voto) FROM iscrizioni i2 WHERE i2.studente_id = rs.studente_id) AS media_verifica, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT s3.id FROM studenti s3 UNION SELECT d3.id FROM dipartimenti d3) AS insieme_unito) AS totale_unito FROM report_studenti rs JOIN report_dipartimenti rd ON rs.dipartimento = rd.dipartimento LEFT JOIN coppie_cognome cc ON rs.studente_id = cc.id1 LEFT JOIN studenti_non_iscritti sni ON rs.studente_id = sni.id WHERE rs.media_voti >= (SELECT AVG(media_voti) FROM report_studenti) AND sni.id IS NULL ORDER BY rs.media_voti DESC LIMIT 5;
